payload.prompt: Whose video series opens with these words?

payload.prompt: Adam, the Ironman tutor in Lumbridge, had his hair dyed purple after which creator did the same for charity?

payload.prompt: The tick-perfect way to keep hitting Vorkath while dodging his dragonfire is named after which player?

payload.prompt: Whose Hardcore Ironman series coined this catchphrase?

payload.prompt: Which YouTuber is famous for opening his videos with this greeting?

payload.prompt: Whose classic RuneScape machinima videos made a meme of headbanging while shouting a god's name?
payload.explanation: TehNoobShow, in the classic Gods Exposed machinima series.

payload.prompt: Which PvP creator's videos frequently open with him whispering from a bush or disguise?
payload.explanation: Torvesta, known for his high-risk Wilderness PKing and undercover skull-trick videos.

payload.prompt: Whose restricted Ironman series begins with this rule?
payload.explanation: Settled's Tileman series, where every movement tile had to be bought with experience all the way to the Infernal cape.

payload.prompt: Paul, the Ultimate Ironman tutor in Lumbridge, is named after which streamer who pioneered unofficial Ironman play?

payload.prompt: Which player designed Rooftop Agility and waves at you from the end of the Seers' Village and Ardougne courses?

payload.prompt: A broken-down tractor in Hosidius is an in-game tribute to which community member whose map designs inspired the Great Kourend rework?

payload.prompt: How did Woox famously survive the final fog in the October 2016 Deadman Invitational before being disqualified?

payload.prompt: Which Fossil Island demi-boss famously ended A Friend's high-ranking Hardcore Ironman, "White Cat22"?

payload.prompt: Which creator hosts Gielinor Games, the survivor-style competition series pitting OSRS creators against each other?

payload.prompt: Which creator is behind By Release, a series completing every quest in chronological order of its original release date?

payload.prompt: Which YouTuber became famous for real-time quest guides that always open with "Hi, and welcome to my guide"?

payload.prompt: What hitsplat did Skill Specs land on B0aty with an Armadyl godsword in 2015, turning the number into an OSRS meme?

payload.prompt: What was the combat level of the lowest-level account on which Rendi obtained a Fire cape in Old School RuneScape?

payload.prompt: Which of these are the names of the three Ironman tutors outside Lumbridge Castle?

payload.prompt: How many US dollars did Mod Ash offer to pay Woox out of his own pocket after Woox was disqualified from the October 2016 Deadman Invitational?

payload.prompt: How many episodes did Settled's Swampletics series run for, from the first episode to the Theatre of Blood finale?

payload.prompt: In his famous Reddit AMA while grinding to become the first player with 200 million XP in every skill, what did Lynx Titan say he ate every day?
options: Bread three times and lasagne once
Two bowls of oatmeal and a pizza

payload.prompt: Which creator popularized the Xtreme Onechunk Ironman ruleset, grinding 99 Defence and 99 Woodcutting before leaving the starting Lumbridge chunk?

payload.prompt: Which creator spent thousands of hours maxing an Ultimate Ironman locked entirely to Karamja?

payload.prompt: Which satirical Wilderness PKer uses a robotic text-to-speech voice to deliver lines like this while sending players back to Lumbridge?

payload.prompt: Which creator launched the 2014 "One Man Army" series, whose self-sufficient rules helped inspire official Ironman Mode?

payload.prompt: Which creator plays through every OSRS quest with no Wiki, no Quest Helper and no outside guides in the series "Unguided"?

payload.prompt: Typing which creator's name into the in-game Collection Log search bar displays this Easter egg?

payload.prompt: Which OSRS creator organizes and hosts the team-based creator tournament "Deadman Allstars"?

payload.prompt: Which free-to-play comedic persona does J1mmy play while wandering World 301 as a perpetually confused new player?

payload.prompt: Which OSRS YouTube duo is known for their competitive "Then We Fight" series, gearing up under odd restrictions before battling in PvP?
